en: Changed `ExitWorktree` to ask before removing a worktree that may hold unsaved work; refused in don't-ask mode or with nobody to answer, unless an allow rule, auto or bypass permissions mode allows it
zh: 变更 `ExitWorktree` 在移除可能含有未保存工作的 worktree 前先询问；在 don't-ask 模式下或无人可应答时拒绝，除非允许规则、auto 或 bypass 权限模式允许
